title: Vibrant Crispy Irish Chicken Quesadilla
description: A fresh, juicy, weeknight Irish-inspired dish featuring crispy chicken, sweet peppers, onions, and smooth Monterey Jack cheese, all wrapped in a gluten-free-friendly tortilla.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, the soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic.
Add the sliced onions to the skillet and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, Panko breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the chicken pieces in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured chicken in the beaten eggs and then coat in the Panko breadcrumb mixture.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated chicken to the skillet and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the quesadillas by placing a piece of crispy chicken on one half of the tortilla, followed by some sautéed onions and bell peppers.
Top with shredded cheese and fold the tortilla in half.
Cook the quesadillas in a large skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately.
